description: Lignes de covoiturage Covoit'ici Pays nantais au format GTFS is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ecov. Lignes de covoiturage Covoit'ici Pays nantais au format GTFS Données descriptives au format GTFS de l’offre de transport (lignes, arrêts, horaires, etc. ) des lignes de covoiturage Covoit'ici du Pays nantais, mises à disposition par Ecov, pour le compte de Nantes Métropole. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are auto, covoiturage, transport en commun. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
